about_short_description.short_description: Outrival provides an AI platform for building conversational agents to automate customer experience and support enrollment teams.

product.name: AI Admissions Assistant
product.description: An AI agent that manages the student enrollment process by engaging prospective students, answering inquiries, and sending follow-ups to guide them from inquiry to enrollment.

product.name: AI Financial Aid Advisor
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that provides guidance on tuition, financial aid, scholarships, and payment plans, handling related queries and facilitating payment processes.

product.name: AI Receptionist
product.description: An AI-driven front desk assistant that handles campus inquiries, routes questions to appropriate departments, and provides multilingual support around the clock.

product.name: OutRival Travel vertical
product.description: A travel-focused AI Digital Worker solution for customer engagement, outbound sales, reservations, service, and loyalty operations.
